record.title: Complete the witnessed stock store and capture the following access
record.intent: Test the next step of the stock initialization sequence with exactly one additional modeled transaction.
requirements: Use the private-controlled executable and byte-identical stock artifacts in a fresh pinned guest.
Permit the two existing reads and exactly the main-thread store at ELF 0x27043c opcode 0xb9000109 offset 0x3000 value 0x05630000.
Record the write and preserve all registers except PC; execute stock return and synchronization code normally.
Stop at the next unsupported access from any covered thread without another response.
Capture thread events, terminal state, preservation and cleanup or classify a precise negative outcome.
acceptance: Compare the next observed access with the static candidate 0x01630000 second write without treating the prediction as a pre-supplied result.
Make no physical ADC, timing, completion or acquisition claim; commit and push the conclusion.
